title: Suppliers router (F-001)
scope: APIRouter(prefix='/suppliers', tags=['suppliers']) exposing GET / (list with include_inactive query), POST / (201 create), PATCH /{supplier_id} (update), DELETE /{supplier_id} (soft delete returns the deactivated row). Uses get_supplier_service via Depends.

success_criteria.manual: Router exports `router`; OpenAPI lists 4 routes after main.py mounts under /api/v1.
success_criteria.automated: TC-033 (POST -> 201 + body), TC-034 (DELETE -> 200 + is_active=false, row preserved).
success_criteria.definition_of_done: 4 endpoints all delegating to SupplierService; DELETE returns the deactivated row, not 204.

checkout_prompt: 'Suppliers router — 4 endpoints, soft DELETE returns deactivated row.'
